description_en: Modifies the firewall rule of a simple application server
description_zh: 修改指定轻量应用服务器的防火墙规则
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open modify-firewall-rule --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --rule-id eeea34d9867b4d55a4ff8d5fcfbd0000 --rule-protocol TCP --port 3306 --source-cidr-ip 10.147.33.00 --remark Custom --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFirewallRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The transport layer protocol. Valid values:

TCP: the TCP protocol

UDP: the UDP protocol

TCP+UDP: the TCP and UDP protocols
parameters.help_zh:
传输层协议。取值范围：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议
parameters.name: rule_protocol

parameters.help_en: The port range. Valid values: 165535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates that the port range of 10241055
parameters.help_zh: 端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The IP address or CIDR block that is allowed in the firewall rule
parameters.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the firewall rule
parameters.name: remark
